event_name: Document 38 Date 11 December 2021 Time 21:01 2021 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 December 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 29 & 30) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Alleged Impeding of Car 10 by Car 5 in Turn 1.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 5 (Sebastian Vettel), the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly) and team representatives, and examined video, team radio and telemetry evidence. The Stewards note that almost certainly there was "dirty air" created by Car 5 which did have an "impact" on Car 10 however the Stewards determine that this does not amount to "unnecessarily impeding".
rules_referenced: Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 5 Alleged Impeding Of Car 10 In Turn 1
